SECTIONS.name: Temeller
SECTIONS.sub: Selamlaşma, tanışma, «be» fiili, sayılar, aile, renkler

units.name: Selamlaşma
tips: How are you?
«Nasılsın?» Cevap: I am fine / I'm fine (İyiyim). «I'm», «I am»ın kısa hâlidir.
Good morning / Good evening
Sabah «good morning», akşam «good evening», yatarken «good night» denir.
units.note: İngilizcede «you» hem «sen» hem «siz» demektir; tek kelimeyle herkese hitap edersin.

story.title: Hello, Emma!
lines: I am fine, thank you. And you?

options: I am fine, thank you. And you?
Good night, Emma.
No, please.

units.name: Tanışma
tips: What is your name?
«What» = ne. Soru kelimesi başa gelir: What is your name? (Adın ne?)
I am from…
«-liyim, -luyum» İngilizcede «I am from + ülke» ile söylenir: I am from Turkey.

story.title: Nice to meet you
lines: Hi! My name is Azad. What is your name?
Selam! Benim adım Azad. Senin adın ne?
I am from England. And you?

options: I am from England. And you?
I am from Turkey. And you?
My name is Azad.

lines: I am from Turkey. Nice to meet you!

units.name: «be» fiili
tips: I am / you are / he is
«be» fiili: I am, you are, he/she/it is, we are, they are. Türkçedeki «-im, -sin, -dir» ekleri gibi.
He is / She is
Türkçede tek «o» var; İngilizcede erkek için «he», kadın için «she», eşya ve hayvan için «it».
I am not
Olumsuz için «not»: I am not, he is not (isn't), they are not (aren't).
units.note: Meslek söylerken «a» kullanılır: She is a teacher. Türkçede «bir» çoğu zaman söylenmez, İngilizcede gerekir.

units.name: Sayılar
sents: My phone number is five, three, one.
tips: How old are you?
Yaş «be» ile söylenir: I am 20 (years old). «I have 20 years» denmez.
two cats
Birden fazlaysa isme -s eklenir: one cat, two cats. Türkçede «iki kediler» denmez ama İngilizcede -s şart.

units.name: Aile
sents: Her brother is ten years old.
tips: my / your / his / her / our / their
İyelik: benim, senin, onun (erkek), onun (kadın), bizim, onların. Ek yerine ismin önüne gelir: my mother = annem.
Emma's brother
's ile sahiplik: Emma's brother = Emma'nın erkek kardeşi.

story.title: Emma's family

options: Yes, she is a teacher.
Yes, he is a doctor.
No, she is a baby.

lines: That is my brother. He is ten.
O benim erkek kardeşim. On yaşında.

units.name: Eşyalar ve renkler
sents: My bag is black and white.
tips: a / an
«bir» anlamında. Sesli harfle başlayan kelimeden önce «an»: a book, an apple.
a red phone
Sıfat ismin önüne gelir, Türkçedeki gibi: kırmızı telefon = red phone.
Is this your key?
Soru yaparken «is» başa geçer: This is… → Is this…?

SECTIONS.name: Günlük hayat
SECTIONS.sub: Yemek, ev, zaman, günlük işler, sevdiklerin

units.name: Yemek ve içecek
sents: I eat bread and cheese for breakfast.
Do you want tea or coffee?
tips: I eat / She eats
Geniş zamanda he, she, it ile fiile -s gelir: I eat, she eats.
I do not drink
Olumsuz: do not (don't) + fiil. He/she/it ile: does not (doesn't): She doesn't drink milk.
I am hungry
«Açım» İngilizcede «be» ile söylenir: I am hungry, I am thirsty (susadım).

story.title: Breakfast
lines: Good morning, Tom! Are you hungry?
Yes, please. And bread and cheese.
Evet, lütfen. Bir de ekmek ve peynir.

options: Yes, please. And bread and cheese.
No, thank you. Just water.
Good night, Mum.

units.name: Ev
sents: There are three rooms in my house.
The chair is next to the table.
My bedroom has a big window.
Yatak odamın büyük bir penceresi var.
tips: There is / There are
«Var» demek: tekil için there is, çoğul için there are. Soru: Is there…? / Are there…?
in / on / under / next to
Yer edatları ismin önüne gelir: in the room (odada), on the table (masada), under the chair (sandalyenin altında), next to (yanında).

units.name: Günler ve saat
tips: on Monday / at three o'clock
Günlerle «on», saatlerle «at»: on Monday, at 3 o'clock.
Monday
Gün ve ay adları büyük harfle yazılır: Monday, Friday, January.

units.name: Günlük işler
sents: She goes to school every day.
My father works in a bank.
We watch TV in the evening.
tips: She goes / He watches
he, she, it ile fiile -s gelir; -o, -sh, -ch ile bitenlere -es: go → goes, watch → watches.
go home
«home» ile «to» kullanılmaz: go home (eve gitmek), ama go to school (okula gitmek).

story.title: Tom's day
lines: What time do you get up, Tom?
Do you go to school by bus?
No, I walk. School is near.

options: No, I walk. School is near.
Yes, I go by bus.
I go home at five.

lines: What do you do in the evening?
I read a book and I sleep at ten.

units.name: Sevdiklerim
tips: I like swimming
«sevmek» fiilinden sonra fiil gelirse -ing alır: I like cooking (yemek yapmayı severim).
I like dogs
Genel olarak sevilen şeyler çoğul söylenir: I like cats (kedileri severim).

units.name: Soru sormak
sents: Yes, I speak a little English.
tips: Do you…? / Does she…?
Geniş zamanda soru: Do + özne + fiil. he/she/it ile Does: Does she live here? (Fiile -s gelmez.)
Where do you live?
Soru kelimesi + do/does + özne + fiil: What do you want? (Ne istiyorsun?)

SECTIONS.name: Çevremde
SECTIONS.sub: Şehir, alışveriş, hava, beden, giysi, yetenekler

units.name: Şehirde
sents: Turn left, then go straight on.
The bank is on the right.
Excuse me, is there a shop near here?
Affedersiniz, buralarda bir dükkân var mı?
tips: Excuse me
Yabancıya soru sormadan önce «Excuse me» (affedersiniz) denir.
Turn left!
Emir cümlesi fiille başlar, özne yok: Turn left (sola dön), Go straight on (düz git).

story.title: Excuse me!
lines: Excuse me, where is the station?
Go straight on and turn left.
No, it is near. Five minutes.

options: No, it is near. Five minutes.
Yes, it is very far.
Turn right at the bank.

units.name: Alışveriş
sents: I want to buy a phone.
tips: How much is / How much are
Tekil için «is», çoğul için «are»: How much is the bag? How much are the shoes?
this → these, that → those
Bu → bunlar, şu → şunlar. Çoğul isimle «these/those» kullanılır.

units.name: Hava ve mevsimler
tips: It is cold
Hava durumunda özne «it»tir: It is hot (hava sıcak), It is windy (rüzgârlı).
in summer
Mevsimlerle «in»: in winter (kışın), in spring (ilkbaharda).

units.name: Beden
sents: I have two arms and two legs.
İki kolum ve iki bacağım var.
tips: foot → feet, tooth → teeth
Bazı çoğullar düzensizdir: foot → feet, tooth → teeth, man → men, child → children.
My head hurts
«Başım ağrıyor»: ağrıyan yer + hurts. Ayrıca: I have a headache.

units.name: Giysiler
sents: She is wearing a beautiful dress.
Put on your hat, it is cold.
tips: trousers / jeans / shorts
Bu kelimeler hep çoğuldur: My trousers are new (pantolonum yeni).
I am wearing
Şu an üzerinde olan için şimdiki zaman: I am wearing a T-shirt.

units.name: Yapabildiklerim
tips: can + fiil
«can» her özneyle aynıdır, fiil yalın kalır: She can swim (She cans / can swims değil).
Can you…?
Soru ve rica: Can you help me? Olumsuz: cannot (can't).

story.title: Can you swim?
lines: Yes, I can. I swim every summer.
I cannot swim, but I can ride a bike.

options: I cannot swim, but I can ride a bike.
I can swim very fast.
I cannot ride a bike.

lines: Can you help me with my English?
İngilizcem için bana yardım edebilir misin?

units.name: Şu an ne yapıyorsun?
sents: I am reading a book now.
She is studying in her room.
tips: am / is / are + -ing
Şimdiki zaman (-iyor): I am reading, he is running, we are waiting.
run → running, write → writing
Bazı fiillerde harf ikilenir (run → running), sondaki -e düşer (write → writing).
units.note: «I read» her zaman yaptığın şey (okurum), «I am reading» şu an yaptığın şey (okuyorum).

SECTIONS.name: Geçmiş ve planlar
SECTIONS.sub: Geçmiş zaman, seyahat, restoran, gelecek planları

units.name: «was / were»
sents: I was at home last night.
tips: was / were
«be»nin geçmişi: I/he/she/it was, you/we/they were. Olumsuz: wasn't, weren't.
I was born
«Doğdum» İngilizcede «was born» ile söylenir: I was born in Diyarbakır.
two days ago
«önce» kelimesi sona gelir: two days ago (iki gün önce).

units.name: Geçmiş zaman (düzenli)
sents: I watched a film last night.
We visited our grandmother on Sunday.
I did not finish my homework.
tips: -ed
Düzenli fiillerde geçmiş zaman -ed ile yapılır ve her özne için aynıdır: I played, she played.
Did you…?
Geçmişte soru: Did + özne + yalın fiil: Did you watch? (Did you watched değil.)
did not
Olumsuz: did not (didn't) + yalın fiil: I didn't finish.

units.name: Geçmiş zaman (düzensiz)
sents: I went to Istanbul last summer.
I met my friends at the café.
He ate a sandwich and drank a coffee.
Bir sandviç yedi ve bir kahve içti.
My father gave me a book.
What did you do at the weekend?
tips: go → went
Düzensiz fiillerin geçmişi ezberlenir: go → went, see → saw, eat → ate, buy → bought.
Did you go?
Soru ve olumsuzda yine yalın fiil: Did you go? I didn't go. (Did you went değil.)

story.title: The weekend
lines: What did you do at the weekend, Rojda?
I went to the sea with my family.
Yes, and we ate fish. It was great!
Evet, bir de balık yedik. Harikaydı!

options: Yes, and we ate fish. It was great!
No, I stayed at home.
I bought a new phone.

lines: I stayed at home and watched films.
Ben evde kaldım ve film izledim.

units.name: Yolculuk
sents: A return ticket to London, please.
Londra'ya gidiş dönüş bir bilet, lütfen.
What time does the train leave?
I go to work by bus.
tips: by bus / by train / on foot
Ulaşım aracı «by» ile: by car, by plane. Yürüyerek: on foot.
Don't forget!
Olumsuz emir: Don't + fiil: Don't forget, don't be late.

story.title: At the station
lines: Tek yön mü, gidiş dönüş mü?
Return, please. What time does the train leave?
Gidiş dönüş, lütfen. Tren kaçta kalkıyor?
At ten fifteen, from platform two.

options: At ten fifteen, from platform two.
At two o'clock, from platform ten.
It arrives at six.

lines: Thank you. Can I pay by card?

units.name: Restoranda
sents: Can I see the menu, please?
I would like the chicken soup.
Can we have the bill, please?
tips: I would like
«I want»ın kibar hâli: I would like (I'd like) a coffee. Soru: Would you like…? (… ister misiniz?)
Can we have…?
Restoranda bir şey isterken: Can I have…? / Can we have…?

story.title: Dinner
lines: Good evening. Are you ready to order?
İyi akşamlar. Sipariş vermeye hazır mısınız?
Yes. I would like the soup, please.
The fish and a salad, please.

options: The fish and a salad, please.
The soup, please.
The chicken and a dessert.

lines: Would you like something to drink?

units.name: Planlar: «going to»
sents: I am going to visit my aunt next week.
We are going to have a holiday in August.
She is going to learn Spanish.
What are you going to do this weekend?
They are going to move to a new house.
tips: be going to + fiil
Önceden kararlaştırılmış planlar için: I am going to study tonight.
It is going to rain
Görünen işaretlere dayanan tahmin: Bulutlara bak, yağmur yağacak.

units.name: Karşılaştırma
sents: My brother is taller than me.
This phone is cheaper than that one.
This book is more interesting than the film.
tips: -er than
Kısa sıfatlara -er: big → bigger, tall → taller. «-den» anlamı «than» ile: taller than me.
more + uzun sıfat
Uzun sıfatlarda «more»: more interesting, more expensive.
good → better, bad → worse
Düzensiz: good → better, bad → worse, far → further.

units.name: En üstünlük
sents: This is the best day of my life!
Everest is the highest mountain in the world.
Who is the tallest in your family?
It is the most famous city in the country.
The Euphrates is a long river.
tips: the + -est
En üstünlük: the biggest, the tallest. Uzun sıfatlarla: the most beautiful.
in the world
«-in en …» yapısında «in»: the best student in the class (sınıfın en iyi öğrencisi).

units.name: Meslekler
sents: She works in a hospital as a nurse.
I have a job interview tomorrow.
tips: What do you do?
«Ne iş yapıyorsun?» sorusu: What do you do? Cevap: I'm a teacher.
as a nurse
«olarak»: She works as a nurse (hemşire olarak çalışıyor).

story.title: A new job
lines: I have a job interview tomorrow.

options: Nurse, at the city hospital.
Engineer, in an office.
Driver, at the airport.

lines: That is great! You are very hard-working.
Thank you. I am a bit nervous.

units.name: Okul
sents: I have a maths exam on Friday.
tips: do homework
Ödev için «do» kullanılır: do homework (make homework değil).
favourite
«En sevdiğim»: my favourite subject. (Amerikan İngilizcesinde favorite.)

units.name: Hobiler ve spor
sents: What do you do in your free time?
I often play chess with my grandfather.
tips: often / sometimes / never
Sıklık zarfları fiilden önce gelir: I often play. Ama «be»den sonra: She is never late.
play / go / do
Top oyunlarıyla play (play football), -ing sporlarla go (go swimming), diğerleriyle do (do yoga).

units.name: Sağlık
sents: I have a headache and a fever.
You should rest and drink water.
You should not eat so much sugar.
I have an appointment with the doctor.
Take this medicine twice a day.
Bu ilacı günde iki kez al.
tips: should + fiil
Tavsiye: You should rest. Olumsuz: shouldn't.
I have a cold
Hastalıklarda «have»: I have a cold (nezleyim), I have a fever (ateşim var).

story.title: At the doctor's
lines: I have a cough and a headache.
You should rest for two days and drink a lot of water.
İki gün dinlenmeli ve bol su içmelisin.

options: You should rest for two days and drink a lot of water.
You should go to work today.
You should eat more sugar.

units.name: Zorunluluk
sents: I have to work on Saturday.
Students have to wear a uniform.
Please be quiet in the library.
tips: must / have to
İkisi de zorunluluk: «must» kural ve güçlü istek, «have to» dış zorunluluk: I have to get up early.
mustn't ≠ don't have to
mustn't = yasak (yapmamalısın); don't have to = gerek yok (yapmasan da olur).

units.name: Miktar
sents: How many apples do you want?
How much water do you drink?
I have a lot of friends.
tips: some / any
Olumlu cümlede some, soru ve olumsuzda any: I have some money. Do you have any money?
many / much
Sayılanlarla many (many apples), sayılamayanlarla much (much water). Olumlu cümlede genelde «a lot of».

units.name: Sıklık ve zaman
sents: I go to the gym twice a week.
Haftada iki kez spor salonuna giderim.
The bus is never on time.
tips: twice a week
«haftada iki kez»: once a day, twice a week, three times a month.
How often…?
«Ne sıklıkla?»: How often do you exercise?

units.name: Davet ve telefon
sents: Would you like to come to my party?
Can you call me back later?
tips: Would you like to…?
Kibar davet: Would you like to come? Cevap: I'd love to! / Sorry, I can't.
Let's
Öneri: Let's + yalın fiil: Let's eat (hadi yiyelim).

story.title: A birthday party
lines: Hi Azad! It is my birthday on Saturday.
Selam Azad! Cumartesi benim doğum günüm.
Would you like to come to my party?
I would love to! What time?

options: I would love to! What time?
Sorry, I am busy.
Maybe next year.

units.name: Ev işleri ve rica
sents: Could you open the window, please?
I wash the dishes after dinner.
Could you lend me ten pounds?
Bana on sterlin ödünç verebilir misin?
tips: Could you…?
«Can you»dan daha kibar rica: Could you help me?
borrow / lend
borrow = ödünç almak (benden alırsın), lend = ödünç vermek (sana veririm).

SECTIONS.name: Deneyimler
SECTIONS.sub: Present perfect, past continuous, alışkanlıklar, gelecek

units.name: Deneyimler
sents: Have you ever been to London?
O iki kez yurt dışına gitti.
Have you ever tried Kurdish food?
I have seen this film three times.
It is the best book I have ever read.
tips: have / has + V3
Present perfect, zamanı belli olmayan deneyimleri anlatır: I have been to Van.
Have you ever…?
«Hiç … oldun mu?»: Have you ever seen snow? Cevap: Yes, I have. / No, I haven't.
been / gone
He has been to Paris (gidip döndü) ≠ He has gone to Paris (gitti, hâlâ orada).
units.note: Zaman belliyse (yesterday, in 2020) present perfect değil geçmiş zaman kullanılır: I went to London in 2020.

units.name: Yeni olanlar
sents: I have just finished my homework.
We have lived here for ten years.
tips: for / since
for + süre (for two years = iki yıldır), since + başlangıç (since 2019 = 2019'dan beri).
just / already / yet
just ve already fiilden önce: I have just eaten. yet soru ve olumsuzun sonunda: Not yet!
I have lived here for…
Türkçedeki «-dır … yaşıyorum» İngilizcede present perfect ile söylenir (I am living here for… değil).

story.title: Lost keys
lines: Oh no! I have lost my keys.
Have you looked in your bag?
Yes, I have already looked there.
Wait… are these your keys? I have just found them on the table.
Bekle… bunlar senin anahtarların mı? Az önce masada buldum.

options: Wait… are these your keys? I have just found them on the table.
Yes, they were in my bag.
I have lost them in the park.

units.name: Geçmişte sürerken
sents: I was walking home when it started to rain.
What were you doing at eight o'clock?
She was cooking while he was reading.
O kitap okurken kadın yemek pişiriyordu.
The phone rang while I was sleeping.
He fell and broke his arm.
tips: was / were + -ing
Geçmişte süren eylem (-iyordu): I was watching TV.
when / while
Uzun eylem (past continuous) kısa eylemle (past simple) kesilir: I was sleeping when the phone rang.

story.title: An accident
lines: Oh no! What were you doing?
I was riding to school when a dog ran in front of me.
Okula gidiyordum, önüme bir köpek fırladı.

options: I was riding to school when a dog ran in front of me.
I was walking in the rain.
I was sleeping when the phone rang.

lines: I hope you feel better soon.

units.name: Eskiden
sents: I used to live in a village.
Did you use to play outside?
She didn't use to like coffee.
Our town has changed a lot.
tips: used to + fiil
Geçmişteki ama artık olmayan alışkanlık: I used to smoke (eskiden sigara içerdim).
didn't use to
Soru ve olumsuzda «use to» (d yok): Did you use to…? I didn't use to…

story.title: Grandfather's village
lines: Where did your grandfather grow up, Rojda?
In a small village near the mountains.
What did he use to do there?
He used to look after sheep and tell stories at night.
Koyun güderdi ve geceleri hikâye anlatırdı.

options: He used to look after sheep and tell stories at night.
He used to work in a bank.
He used to live in London.

units.name: Gelecek ve tahmin
sents: I think it will rain tomorrow.
Don't worry, I will help you.
I promise I won't be late.
People will probably live on Mars one day.
İnsanlar muhtemelen bir gün Mars'ta yaşayacak.
tips: will
Anlık kararlar, sözler, teklifler ve tahminler: I'll call you. It will be sunny.
will / going to
Plan önceden yapıldıysa going to: I am going to visit Van. O an karar verildiyse will: I'll get the phone!

SECTIONS.name: Koşullar ve yapılar
SECTIONS.sub: If cümleleri, edilgen, ilgi cümleleri, aktarma

units.name: Gerçek koşullar
sents: If it rains, we will stay at home.
If you don't hurry, you will miss the bus.
I will call you as soon as I arrive.
Take an umbrella in case it rains.
If you heat ice, it melts.
My mother will be angry if I am late.
tips: If + geniş zaman, will + fiil
Gerçek olasılık: If it rains, I will stay home. If'li kısımda «will» kullanılmaz.
unless
if not: Unless you study, you will fail (çalışmazsan kalırsın).

units.name: Hayalî koşullar
sents: If I were rich, I would travel around the world.
If I won the lottery, I would buy a house.
What would you do if you lived on an island?
If I were you, I would talk to her.
I wish I could speak English fluently.
tips: If + geçmiş zaman, would + fiil
Hayalî/şimdiki gerçek dışı durum: If I had time, I would help you.
If I were you
Tavsiye kalıbı: If I were you, I would… (Senin yerinde olsam…). «were» her özneyle kullanılabilir.

story.title: The lottery
lines: What would you do if you won the lottery?
I would buy a house by the sea. And you?
Deniz kenarında bir ev alırdım. Ya sen?
I would travel around the world.

options: I would travel around the world.
I would buy a house by the sea.
I would stay at home.

lines: No, I love my job too much!

units.name: Edilgen yapı
sents: Kurdish is spoken in many countries.
This carpet was made by hand.
The telephone was invented by Bell.
tips: be + V3
Edilgen: işi yapan değil iş önemli olduğunda. It is made (yapılır), it was made (yapıldı).
by
İşi yapanı söylemek için «by»: written by Ehmedê Xanî (Ehmedê Xanî tarafından yazılmış).

units.name: İlgi cümleleri
sents: The man who lives next door is a doctor.
This is the book which I told you about.
That is the café where we first met.
She is the woman whose son plays football.
I like people who are honest.
The film that we watched was boring.
tips: who / which / that
İnsanlar için who, eşyalar için which, ikisi için that. Türkçedeki «-en, -dığı» eklerinin karşılığı.
where / whose
Yer için where (the house where I was born = doğduğum ev), sahiplik için whose.
units.note: Türkçede ilgi eki ismin önüne gelir (yan dairede oturan adam), İngilizcede sonra: the man who lives next door.

units.name: Aktarma
sents: She said that she was tired.
He told me that he loved the city.
They asked me where I lived.
I asked whether the shop was open.
The teacher explained the rule again.
tips: say / tell
say + söz (She said hello), tell + kişi (She told me the news).
am → was
Aktarırken zaman genelde bir geri gider: «I am tired» → She said (that) she was tired.

SECTIONS.name: Dünya ve fikirler
SECTIONS.sub: Fiil kalıpları, doğa, teknoloji, duygular, kültür

units.name: -ing mi, to mu?
sents: Do you mind opening the window?
I need to finish this report.
We are planning to visit Hakkari.
tips: enjoy / finish / mind / avoid + -ing
Bu fiillerden sonra -ing gelir: I enjoy cooking.
want / decide / hope / need + to
Bu fiillerden sonra to + fiil: I want to go.
stop smoking / stop to smoke
stop + -ing = bırakmak; stop + to = bir şey yapmak için durmak.

units.name: Doğa ve çevre
sents: Air pollution is a big problem in cities.
Hava kirliliği şehirlerde büyük bir sorun.
We planted trees in the forest.
tips: should / shouldn't
Öneri ve görüş: We should save energy.
a lot of / lots of
Bol miktar: There is a lot of waste.

story.title: Planting trees
lines: What are you doing this weekend?
We are going to plant trees with my school.
Because the forest near our town burned last summer.
Çünkü kasabamızın yakınındaki orman geçen yaz yandı.

options: Because the forest near our town burned last summer.
Because they want to sell wood.
Because it is raining.

lines: Of course! The more people, the better.
Tabii! Ne kadar çok kişi, o kadar iyi.

units.name: Teknoloji
sents: Don't spend too much time in front of the screen.
Can you send me the link?
tips: spend time + -ing
Zaman geçirmek: I spend too much time watching videos.
online / offline
Çevrimiçi / çevrimdışı. «on the internet» da denir.

units.ku: How do you feel about it?
units.name: Duygular ve fikirler
sents: I am really excited about the trip.
She was disappointed with her exam results.
In my opinion, the book is better than the film.
I am not sure I agree.
We are very proud of you.
tips: -ed / -ing
Duygu sıfatları: I am bored (canım sıkılıyor) ≠ The film is boring (film sıkıcı).
excited about / proud of / worried about
Sıfatla birlikte gelen edatlar ezberlenir: proud of (…ile gurur duymak).

story.title: The exam results
lines: I got my exam results today.
I passed! I am so surprised.
I am not surprised. You studied very hard.

options: I am not surprised. You studied very hard.
I am very worried about you.
You did not study at all.

lines: Thank you. My parents are very proud of me.
Teşekkürler. Ailem benimle çok gurur duyuyor.

units.name: Kültür ve gelenekler
sents: Newroz is celebrated on the twenty-first of March.
People jump over the fire and dance together.
İnsanlar ateşin üzerinden atlar ve birlikte halay çeker.
Guests are always welcome in our house.
Evimizde misafirler her zaman hoş karşılanır.
The storyteller told an old legend.
Hikâye anlatıcısı eski bir efsane anlattı.
How many languages do you speak?
Weddings in my village last for three days.
tips: is celebrated
Gelenekleri anlatırken edilgen yapı sık kullanılır: Newroz is celebrated in spring.
on the 21st of March
Tarihlerde «on»: on the 21st of March / on March 21st.

story.title: Newroz
lines: It is the Kurdish new year. It is celebrated on March 21st.
We light a fire, wear colourful clothes and dance.
Ateş yakıyoruz, renkli giysiler giyiyoruz ve halay çekiyoruz.

options: We light a fire, wear colourful clothes and dance.
We stay at home and watch TV.
We buy a big cake.

lines: It sounds wonderful! Can I come next year?
Of course! You are always welcome.
Tabii! Her zaman başımızın üstünde yerin var.

units.name: Deyimsel fiiller
sents: I am looking for my glasses.
Can you look after my cat this weekend?
Bu hafta sonu kedime bakabilir misin?
We got off the bus at the last stop.
I will pick you up at six.
We have run out of milk.
tips: Phrasal verb
Fiil + küçük kelime yeni bir anlam verir: look (bakmak) → look for (aramak), look after (bakmak, ilgilenmek).
turn it off
Nesne zamir ise araya girer: Turn it off (Turn off it değil).

SAYINGS: Where there's a will, there's a way.
Söz uçar, yazı kalır; iş konuşur.
Every cloud has a silver lining.
Rome wasn't built in a day.
A friend in need is a friend indeed.
Don't judge a book by its cover.
Two heads are better than one.
Bir elin nesi var, iki elin sesi var.
